title: First Battle of Basilisk

date.uncertainty: the supplied extract says 2 October 1900 PD; the wiki infobox and timeline give 3 September 1901 PD

location: Basilisk system, between Medusa and the hyper limit
summary: HMS Fearless, a light cruiser rebuilt around an experimental grav lance, runs down the Havenite Q-ship Sirius before she can reach the hyper limit and summon a waiting task force. Crippled by laserheads, Fearless plays dead, lets Sirius close and destroys her with the lance and energy torpedoes.

frame.axes: Origin at Basilisk-A. +X outward through Medusa at the moment Sirius breaks orbit, which is also Sirius's course to the hyper limit; +Y along Medusa's orbital motion; +Z normal to the orbital plane. A plotting convention, not an astronomical orientation.

ftl_speed_c.uncertainty: declared provisional grav-pulse preset (MTS Appendix A); no FTL traffic in this battle
